why: The must_not list forbids a FAIL on line 1 or line 2. Line 2 is PASS, so that part holds. Line 1 is marked "result": "FAIL". The evidence for it even admits that the wrong build passes the run proof (`node bin/greet.js --shout Ada` prints HELLO, ADA!). The only reason it gives is that no regression test was added, and it says "No line requires a regression test for --shout". So it fails line 1 for a requirement the line doesn't contain. Because line 1 is a FAIL, the output does something on the must_not list, and the criterion is not met.
